dialogues.speaker: "Intrepid Valberry"
dialogues.text: Ha! Done nothing wrong... I know you young'uns all like to save face.

dialogues.speaker: "Intrepid Valberry"
dialogues.text: Eh, forget it. I won't ask. Though it seems we're somewhat bound together by fate, so if anyone gives you any trouble, you come tell me, and I'll help you out.
